name: Junior Market Research Consultant (m/f/d)
keywords: market research,quantitative research,data analysis,berlin,junior,statistics,quantitative methods,research methods,entry level,data visualization
description:
Does this sound like you?

  • Do you find genuine joy in analysing data and uncovering the story within it, and do you have a solid grounding in quantitative research methods to back that up?
  • Do you do your best work as part of a close-knit team, and feel comfortable navigating the pace and complexity that come with international client projects?
  • And does the potential path to grow towards leading your own projects for major global clients in financial services and enterprise technology excite you?

Then join our Berlin team!

Factworks is a boutique quantitative research firm. We work with the world's leading financial services, technology and media companies on the research challenges that genuinely matter to them: pricing strategy, segmentation, customer experience and loyalty. The methods we use, including choice-based conjoint analysis, advanced segmentation and large-scale trackers, are technically demanding and highly custom, and our clients trust us with their most important and complex research challenges.

We are a team of roughly 65 people across Berlin, Silicon Valley and Bangalore. Our academic backgrounds span psychology, business administration and economics, statistics, engineering and the social sciences. Being a trusted partner is at the heart of what we do. We hold ourselves to high standards and are passionate about delivering excellence for our clients. At the same time, we foster an open and motivating environment where new ideas and fresh perspectives are always welcome.

Joining us means:

  • A structured introduction to quantitative research at a level of methodological depth that is rare in the industry
  • Exposure from the start to real client challenges from major global financial services, technology and media companies
  • A collaborative, intellectually curious team that takes the work seriously without being hierarchical about it
  • Genuine flexibility in how you work, alongside the expectation that you are present and engaged when it matters
  • The potential to grow towards a project lead role, supported by active investment in your development along the way

The core requirements:

  • A Master's degree (or PhD) in a quantitatively oriented discipline: business, economics, psychology, statistics or a related field
  • Solid statistical and methodological grounding: a strong foundation in statistics, quantitative research methods and mathematical reasoning. You are comfortable with the underlying logic of what the numbers are doing, not just running them through software
  • Hands-on experience with statistical software: you have used at least one tool such as SPSS, Stata, R, Q or similar to clean data, run analyses and interpret the output, whether in a previous role or through your studies
  • Clear, structured output creation: you can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and visualisations that a non-technical audience can follow easily
  • AI tool literacy: you use tools like Claude or ChatGPT for drafting, structuring and sense-checking, you can write effective prompts, and you apply sound judgement about where AI genuinely helps and where it does not
  • Strong working habits: you keep your work easy to follow, with well-documented files, clear naming conventions, and project steps that others can pick up without needing additional explanation
  • Hands-on experience with quantitative data: cleaning, processing and digging into datasets to extract meaningful findings. This is work you enjoy and are eager to do more of
  • Domain curiosity: you have a genuine interest in financial services and technology industries and a desire to build domain knowledge on the job
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken): this is our working language across all offices and client communications
  • Office tools: you are proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

Additionally useful:

  • Practical experience in a professional environment such as an internship, research assistant role or consulting engagement — particularly within financial services
  • Working knowledge of Python or R for data wrangling and automation, beyond standard statistical software
  • Experience running a full research project from design through to reporting
  • Some familiarity with survey platforms (Decipher/Forsta, Qualtrics or similar)
  • German language skills are a plus, but not required

We are looking for a Junior Market Research Consultant to join our Berlin team. You will be embedded in live client projects from the start, working closely with data to support the delivery of compelling, actionable research.

The role is analytically focused at entry level: data processing, analysis, interpretation and preparing the output that underpins our client presentations. Over time, you will take on more of the project management dimensions of the role, with a clear path towards a project leading position for those who develop the skills, client knowledge and ambition to get there.

In practice, this means:

  • Work closely with quantitative datasets: cleaning, processing, running frequencies, building analysis files and identifying patterns that matter
  • Prepare chart output and visualisations for client-facing presentations, translating analytical findings into clear, structured stories
  • Support survey programming and fieldwork management across ad-hoc and tracking studies
  • Collaborate with project leads on study design, questionnaire development and interpretation of results
  • Use AI tools as part of day-to-day work for drafting, structuring and sense-checking, while applying sound judgement about outputs
  • Gradually take ownership of individual project phases, with the potential to move into full project management as your skills, industry and client knowledge develop

We provide a range of benefits to help our team perform at their very best:

  • Flexible hours
  • Hybrid work options
  • Ongoing training and development, both on-the-job and external
  • Subsidized monthly Urban Sports Club membership
  • Regular team events
  • Company pension plan
  • BVG transport subsidy
  • Extra day off on your birthday

You'll find more details on these benefits on our career page.

Numbers are what we do and it's our people who make them count.

Fact: Data means nothing without interpretation. You've got to put numbers to work to make them matter. At Factworks, that's precisely what we do. We're a team of curious minds spread across three offices in Berlin, Germany, Bangalore, India, and Silicon Valley, U.S., all motivated by the drive to solve complex challenges through in-depth research and actionable insights.

Each Factworker possesses unique expertise, but our true strength lies in how we unite these individual superpowers through close collaboration and continuous learning. Together, we answer the most critical and strategic research questions for Silicon Valley giants and rising stars, never forgetting to have fun along the way.

Factworks is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We promote equal opportunities regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity.




Follow us for more updates on LinkedIn and Instagram.
Stay informed: To ensure you receive our updates and application status, please add @personio.de to your safe senders list or allowlist. We use Personio to manage our recruitment communications, and sometimes these emails can land in spam or junk folders.

name: Senior IT System Administrator (m/f/d)
keywords: System Administrator,IT administrator,IT Team Lead,Microsoft Azure,Entra ID,Windows Server,Google Workspace,Cybersecurity,SOC 2,Incident Response
description:
Does this sound like you?
  • Do you wish to leverage your technical expertise and navigate complex IT challenges toward effective solutions?
  • Are you experienced in building and consulting on resilient and secure IT infrastructure that ensures optimal organizational performance?
  • Would you like to apply your forward-thinking mindset, lead a small IT team and shape the selection of cutting-edge IT solutions, including AI tools?

Sounds like you? Then join our Berlin team!

Why Join Us?

We are looking to strengthen our existing IT department and are seeking an experienced Senior IT System Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with our Head of IT, take on people responsibility for a small Berlin-based IT team and be the go-to IT expert in our Berlin office. You will play an instrumental role in shaping how we work and will influence what tools and solutions we decide to implement. You will enjoy working in a flexible and agile environment where your ideas and suggestions will be encouraged. Join and support the team of Factworkers by maintaining and shaping a state-of-the-art workspace to enable them to answer the most critical and strategic research questions for Silicon Valley giants and rising stars.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for the following:

  • Successfully completed studies in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
  • Several years’ relevant experience working preferably in a hands-on SMB or at a Managed Service Provider (MSP)
  • Comprehensive expertise in Windows server/client OS’, Microsoft Azure/Entra ID Management tools and Google Workspace administration
  • Extensive knowledge as well as a deep understanding of the fundamentals of network infrastructure concepts, virtualization technologies, permission concepts, and backup and recovery strategies/concepts, including the implementation and maintenance of projects in these areas
  • Proven experience with cybersecurity practices and tools (incl. SIEM / security monitoring), with a track record of leading incident response end-to-end
  • Hands-on experience implementing and evidencing SOC 2 (or ISO 27001) controls, ideally incl. control ownership in an external audit
  • Experience with the secure administration of AI tools and platforms
  • Experience in leading IT staff, at least functionally (e.g., coordinating and reviewing the work of others, coaching colleagues); experience as a line manager is a plus
  • Strong decision-making and delegation skills, combined with a consultative, solution-oriented approach
  • Resilient and responsible, staying calm and structured under pressure
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects
  • Experienced with documenting processes and changes and maintaining this documentation
  • Excellent command of English (level C1 or above); German is a plus

What You'll Do

As a Senior IT System Administrator at Factworks, you'll be pivotal in maintaining the smooth operation and optimal performance of our IT infrastructure. Leveraging extensive experience and technical expertise, you will manage the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of our complex systems and networks. This role encompasses overseeing, configuring, and troubleshooting servers, storage systems, virtualization environments, networks, and cloud services.

Collaborating with other IT professionals, you will implement and enforce robust security measures in line with our SOC 2 policies, maintain backup and recovery strategies, and design disaster recovery plans, ensuring our IT infrastructure remains secure and resilient. Your proactive problem-solving approach and keen awareness of emerging technologies will drive continuous improvement and innovation within the IT landscape at Factworks.

In addition to technical duties, you'll manage our hardware, software, and service platforms, consult with senior management to align IT assets with business objectives, and handle various operational tasks. You'll act as first responder for security incidents during European business hours and administer our approved AI tools in line with our AI governance framework. As line manager of our Berlin-based IT colleagues, you'll coordinate their day-to-day work within the priorities set by our Head of IT.

We provide a range of benefits to help our team perform at their very best:

  • Flexible hours
  • Hybrid work options
  • Ongoing training and development, both on-the-job and external
  • Subsidized monthly Urban Sports Club membership
  • Regular team events
  • Company pension plan
  • BVG transport subsidy
  • Extra day off on your birthday
